QuestInfo.name: Evil in the Sun
QuestInfo.1:
This time, remnants of the Devil Clan were found in the Nihal Desert.
Go to #m260020610# right away!
QuestInfo.2:
You finally found Yun Wu in the Nihal Desert. He looked like he's been withering away, but surprisingly, he was excited to see you. 
He kept his distance while taunting you, now more powerful after learning the clan's techniques, and you could do little as his henchmen got in your way. 
He escaped... again.
